subject: Orgacorp Jun15 Exec Workshop — Day 0 arrival, venue access & virtual runbook
messages:
From: Kate Morgan <kate.morgan@orgacorp.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: events@orgacorp.com, tom.ellis@orgacorp.com
Date: Fri, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orgacorp Jun15 Exec Workshop — Day 0 ops questions

Hi Grace & Monica,

Thanks again for confirming Jun 15-17 for the exec workshop. A few ops items before we lock calendars:

- Can Redwood provide a Day 0 runbook (arrival, room access, AV contact, virtual bridge) so our facilities team can pre-clear badges?
- We typically request a single virtual bridge for the full workshop (preferred provider: Redwood Zoom bridge or a Teams fallback) — what's your standard link + passcode flow?
- Any preferred arrival window for Redwood staff (we have limited lobby reentry after 6pm)?

Also attaching a rough venue map — expect 80 attendees for Day 1 (exec+engineers) and ~20 remote observers.

If we can get a short Day 0 playbook by next Tuesday (12th), that would let Orgacorp logistics finalize vendor staffing.

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Morgan
Head of Programs — Orgacorp
kate.morgan@orgacorp.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: kate.morgan@orgacorp.com
Date: Fri, 09 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orgacorp Jun15 Exec Workshop — Day 0 ops questions

Team — forwarding Orgacorp's asks. High level plan I propose:

1) Day 0 runbook (deliverable): arrival check, badge pickup instructions, on-site Redwood lead, AV contact, virtual bridge + backup, emergency on-call. I can draft and send back by EOD Tue (12th) if we align now.

2) Virtual bridge: we can host a Redwood Zoom bridge (preferred) and provide a passcode + registration link. Logan, can you confirm capacity for 120 concurrent participants (they said ~80 in-person + remote observers)? If Zoom is tight, Vivek, suggest Teams fallback and we publish both.

3) AV & credentialing: Karthik, please share the AV lead (phone + on-site ext) and whether we need to pre-stage any microphones or HDMI adapters. Monica — can you confirm which Redwood staff are travelling on Day 0 and preferred arrival windows (we should avoid after 6pm for reentry).

4) Attachments: I'll add agenda and a simple floorplan to the runbook. We'll include a short script for onsite intros and a 1-off hotfix plan if the primary model endpoint has latency issues.

If everyone OK, I'll draft the runbook and send to Kate + Events.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-1222

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: kate.morgan@orgacorp.com
Date: Fri, 09 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orgacorp Jun15 Exec Workshop — Day 0 ops questions

Grace — quick notes from infra/ops side:

- Zoom bridge: I can reserve a Redwood-hosted Zoom meeting for up to 250 participants. Will create a registration link and passcode; can stagger admissions if needed.
- AV lead: Tomas Rivera (tomas.r@redwood.ai) will be onsite for Day 0 and Day 1. His mobile: +1 (408) 555-0202. He'll pre-stage 2 lapel mics, 1 roaming handheld, and an HDMI switcher.
- Connectivity: venue has 1 Gbps drop on Level 2; recommending we bring a cellular failover (Cradlepoint) — Vivek, can you arrange an LTE gateway?
- Travel list: Monica, can you confirm who from Redwood will arrive on Jun14 evening vs Jun15 morning? We need lobby badges and parking passes.

I'll draft the Zoom registration + passcode and share the link by Monday.

— Logan
Logan Wright | Senior Field Ops, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Kate Morgan <kate.morgan@orgacorp.com>, events@orgacorp.com, tom.ellis@orgacorp.com
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 May 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Day 0 runbook + virtual bridge (Orgacorp Jun15 — attached)

Kate / Events team — thanks for the details. Attaching our Day 0 runbook and a simple Level 2 floorplan (both enclosed). Summary below:

- Arrival & badges: Redwood reps should check in at the main lobby between 15:00-18:00 on Jun14 (preferred). Orgacorp security will issue day badges if guests arrive earlier; after 18:00 there is limited reentry.
- On-site leads: Grace O'Connor (redwood lead) — +1 (650) 555-1222; Tomas Rivera (AV lead) — +1 (408) 555-0202.
- Virtual bridge (primary): Redwood Zoom bridge (registration required)
  • Link: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210
  • Passcode: Org2027!
  • Registration link: https://redwood.zoom.us/registrations/abc123
- Backup bridge (Teams): will be standing by; we will publish the Teams link only if Zoom experiences issues.
- Connectivity: Logan will bring a cellular LTE gateway as failover.
- AV kit: 2 lapels, 1 handheld, HDMI switcher; Tomas will confirm mic line checks at 08:00 on Jun15.
- Emergency on-call: +1 (650) 555-9999 (Redwood on-call for the event)

Action items for Orgacorp:
- Please share any visitor badge list by Jun12 COB (so security can pre-clear).
- Confirm dietary restrictions for Redwood staff catering by Jun10.

I'll keep the runbook to one page for logistics and a one-paragraph intro for the exec audience. Let me know if you want additional vendor contacts in the doc.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Engagement Lead — Redwood Inference
